name: e2e
description: Next generation e2e testing framework for web and mobile apps.
readme_excerpt: e2e is an end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps. Describe a goal in natural language and an agent drives the app to reach it. Check the result with locators and assertions in the same test.

name: openrig
description: Build your own network of agents from Claude Code, Codex and Pi: persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.
readme_excerpt: A harness wraps a model. A rig wraps your harnesses. Define your agent team in YAML, boot it with one command. Claude Code and Codex in the same rig, managed as one system.

name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
readme_excerpt: My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding.

name: hyperframes
description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
readme_excerpt: HyperFrames is an open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. Use it locally with the CLI, from AI coding agents with skills, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.

name: text-to-cad
readme_excerpt: The text-to-cad plugin gives your agent local workflows for generating 3D models as STEP, GLB, STL or 3MF files. It also does design for manufacturing checks, generates engineering drawings, and connects to popular 3D printing, sheet metal and CNC fabrication services.

name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
readme_excerpt: Official Cursor plugins for popular developer tools, frameworks, and SaaS products. Each plugin is a standalone directory at the repository root with its own .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest.

name: AnyPS5
description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
readme_excerpt: Tool for automatic executables porting to Linux and Windows.

name: OpenShell
description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
readme_excerpt: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents. Agents are most useful when they can read files, install packages, call APIs, and use credentials. OpenShell gives them that capability without giving them unrestricted access to your data, secrets, or network. You declare what each agent can touch in a policy, and OpenShell enforces it.

name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
readme_excerpt: Design guidance for AI coding agents. 1 skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration, and 60 deterministic detector rules for AI-generated frontend design.

name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

name: i-have-adhd
description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
readme_excerpt: Install the i-have-adhd skill/plugin from https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd, refer to the repo's AGENTS.md for instructions.

name: yoinks
description: yoink any video from your terminal. no shady ads.
readme_excerpt: Download videos from YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram, Threads, TikTok and 1,800+ other sites — right from your terminal. Paste a url, pick a resolution (or audio-only mp3), done. No popups, no fake download buttons, no sketchy redirects.
